name: Yang Dimension / co-VC Dimension (affine)
details: For every finite nonempty binary class, $\mathrm Y\ge\mathrm{coVC}-1$. The proof holds over every coefficient field, including the catalogue's default $\mathbb F_2$; a size-$t$ hollow star gives a simplex-boundary hole contributing $t-1$ to Yang dimension.
proof_source: Proposition \ref{prop:yang-hollow-star} in the LaTeX survey, using the induced-literal Hochster formula with the ideal/quotient shift explicit. The hollow-star argument is also recorded in the sibling YangDim draft.
witness_verification: On the full cube $2^{[n]}$, Yang dimension is $n$ and co-VC is zero. These database-owned endpoint values rule out every reverse affine bound, even every finite-valued bound of Yang dimension in co-VC alone.
